title: Shrimp Scampi Foil Packets
description: Jumbo shrimp baked in foil with garlic, white wine, butter and lemon for an easy, fragrant dinner.
ingredients: 500 g jumbo shrimp, peeled and deveined
steps: Divide the shrimp, garlic, wine, butter and lemon slices between foil packets.
Seal and bake at 200C for 12-15 minutes.
Open carefully and finish with parsley.

source.label: Adapted from Skinnytaste shrimp scampi foil packets

notes: Foil packets mean the garlic-butter sauce stays concentrated rather than evaporating in the oven.
